svg.title: Type 1 proposed integrated audio and frequency-reference link
svg.desc: A source master clock governs audio production and a qualified Ethernet transmit reference. The DAC recovers the line frequency, disciplines its local audio oscillator, and converts buffered audio. Return Ethernet control remains present.
